story_info.title: Toby Turtle's Thirsty Flowers
story_info.subtitle: A kind adventure in Blossom Meadow
story_info.moral: It is good to care for nature and help living things.

slides.title: A Walk in the Meadow
slides.text: Toby Turtle loved Blossom Meadow. His gentle brown eyes always looked for new things. One sunny morning, he walked slowly through the soft grass. His teal-green shell shimmered in the light. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he said softly. He saw many colourful flowers. Red, yellow, and blue flowers smiled up at the sun.

slides.title: Sad, Thirsty Flowers
slides.text: Toby moved past the happy, bright flowers. He went towards a quiet corner of the meadow. There, some small flowers looked very sad. Their petals were droopy and their leaves hung low. "Oh dear," Toby thought with a frown. "These flowers look very thirsty." The warm sun made them feel tired.

slides.title: A Clever Idea
slides.text: Toby wanted to help the thirsty flowers. But how could he give them water? He was a small turtle. He did not have a watering can with him. He looked around the meadow carefully. "What can I do?" he thought, his brow wrinkled. He saw a little stream flowing nearby. It had cool, clear water.

slides.title: Toby's Helping Flippers
slides.text: Toby had a good idea! He dipped his big, smooth blue-green flipper into the stream. He scooped up a little cool water. Then, very carefully, he carried it to the sad flowers. He gently poured the water onto their soil. It was a slow, steady job. Toby did not give up. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" he mumbled.

slides.title: Happy Flowers Again
slides.text: Slowly, the little flowers began to perk up. Their colourful petals lifted towards the sun. Their green leaves stood taller. Toby watched them smile again. He felt very happy and warm inside. He had helped nature bloom. Now the Blossom Meadow was full of happy, healthy flowers. Toby felt calm knowing he cared for his world.
